Chapter 09 / 09ARCHITECTURE

Keep evidence attached to every claim.

Provenance is the trace from a conclusion to the source and supporting passage. Citations should survive every merge and summary.

Question #9 · diagnosis: A

Synthesis loses attribution even though upstream agents cite sources. Require structured claim–source mappings and preserve them during merging. Reconstructing attribution from transcripts or semantic similarity later is more fragile.

A minimal evidence record

Use claim_id, claim, source_id, URL, section or passage, retrieval date and limitations. When deduplicating claims, keep all supporting and contradicting evidence. A citation check verifies support; it cannot make an unsupported claim true.

Practice

What input is missing? Who owns the next action? What evidence must survive? Explain the failure before choosing a component.
